svg.title: A-101 First Floor Plan — Detached Villa
svg.text: CANTILEVER — SINGLE ASYMMETRIC CURVE, 2.00 m WEST → 1.50 m EAST
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Final draft — layout agreed. The living floor: a living
area and three sleeping rooms. The living area is 32.3 m²
with the stair standing in it and the pantry open along
the spine, opening through a sliding door onto the
2. The pantry is a counter against the solid stretch of
spine, not the walled room the third floor has. The lobby
has no wall to the living area either: the spine is opened
3.69 m between the columns at y 8.46 and 12.56, so over
that length it is a downstand beam rather than a wall.
3. The west strip is otherwise the third floor's and the east
strip the second's, so the wet rooms sit over their
counterparts and the stair lines through. Bedrooms 2 and 3
take the north off the hall; east and north carry ordinary
windows, the west louvred ventilation only.
4. The master bedroom's north wall is 1.30 m further north
than the suite below it, taking it to 19.6 m²; the shared
bath gives up the same depth, at 5.4 m².
5. The south cantilever repeats the third floor's: the same
asymmetric curve, 2.00 m west sweeping to 1.50 m east,
17.4 m², with sliding doors from the living area and the
master bedroom. The second floor has none, so the two do
Final draft — layout agreed with the client; not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P2 2026-09-24 east windows, taller floors, garden on A-100
P3 2026-09-29 four storeys, apartments, straight north boundary
P4 2026-09-29 north and east opened up, light court removed
P5 2026-10-06 detached villa: 1.00 m setbacks, wave cantilever
